name: Orthodread
look: eight angry teeth set in a horseshoe like dentures on a pink plate, wearing steel caps, a braces wire and brackets with coloured elastics, spiked corner caps and four clawed steel legs
entry: Eight teeth held together by braces it can never take off. It scuttles through dark caves on its steel legs and its bite can crunch through iron. The braces put it in a foul mood, and it takes that out on anyone it meets.
how: Wild: very rare in the Deep Dark and Dripstone Caves.
